山.english: surname Shan; mountain; hill (CL:座[zuo4]); (coll.) small bundle of straw for silkworms to spin cocoons on

館.english: building; shop; term for certain service establishments; embassy or consulate; schoolroom (old); CL:家[jia1]

安.english: surname An; (bound form) calm; peaceful; to calm; to set at ease; safe; secure; in good health; content; satisfied (as in 安於|安于[an1 yu2]); to place (sb) in a suitable position (job); to install; to fix; to fit; to bring (a charge against sb); to harbor (certain intentions); ampere (abbr. for 安培[an1 pei2])

旁.english: one side; other; different; lateral component of a Chinese character (such as 刂[dao1], 亻[ren2] etc)

盧.english: surname Lu; abbr. for Luxembourg 盧森堡|卢森堡[Lu2 sen1 bao3]; (old) rice vessel; black; old variant of 廬|庐[lu2]; (slang) (Tw) troublesome; fussy

快.english: rapid; quick; speed; rate; soon; almost; to make haste; clever; sharp (of knives or wits); forthright; plainspoken; gratified; pleased; pleasant

現代.english: Hyundai, South Korean company; modern times; modern age; modern era

一種.english: one kind of; one type of

一樣.english: same; like; equal to; the same as; just like

得到.english: to get; to obtain; to receive

百年.english: hundred years; century; (fig.) a whole lifetime; a person's whole life

出來.english: to come out; to appear; to arise; (after a verb, indicates coming out, completion of an action, or ability to discern or detect)

可以.english: can; may; possible; able to; not bad; pretty good

一個.english: a; an; one; the whole (afternoon, summer vacation etc)

看看.english: to take a look at; to examine; to survey; (coll.) pretty soon

大學.english: the Great Learning, one of the Four Books 四書|四书[Si4 shu1] in Confucianism; university; college; CL:所[suo3]

留下.english: to leave behind; to stay behind; to remain; to keep; not to let (sb) go

有沒有.english: (before a noun) Do (you, they etc) have ...?; Is there a ...?; (before a verb) Did (you, they etc) (verb, infinitive)?; Have (you, they etc) (verb, past participle)?
